en: The Triplet of the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couple of the Root and the Conjoined with the Root (Hetuhetusampayuttaduka).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, which is both a cause and associated with a cause, there arises a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive, which is neither a cause nor dissociated from a cause, by way of the root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition, there are three; ...
pe ... under the non-disappearance condition, there are three.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, which is both associated with a root and not itself a root, there arises a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive, neither dissociated from a root nor not a root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are three; ...
pe ... under non-disappearance-condition there are three.
